subject: [AMBER] AMBER-Reflector e-mails being sent to SPAM

messages.author: Gustavo Seabra
messages.body:
Hi all,
I use a gmail address for the AMBER lists. For a long time already, I've
noticed that a significant number of e-mails from the AMBER list gets
labelled as 'SPAM'. I don't see a pattern here.
I wonder if anyone else experiences this and, in this case, did you find a
solution other than regularly checking the spambox for AMBER e-mails?
Best,
--
Gustavo Seabra.

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
Hi Gustavo, yes this happened to me more often than not.
I use gmail, and I had to set up a filter to keep them out of spam. It
works well.
Now my Amber emails say this at the top:
This message was not sent to Spam because of a filter you created.
carlos
